description: Attention recruitment agencies: All agency inquiries are vetted through 4DMT’s internal Talent Acquisition team.

raw.title: Vice President, Clinical Operations
raw.excerpt: Attention recruitment agencies: All agency inquiries are vetted through 4DMT’s internal Talent Acquisition team.
raw.description:
Attention recruitment agencies: All agency inquiries are vetted through 4DMT’s internal Talent Acquisition team. No unsolicited resumes will be accepted. The 4DMT Talent Acquisition team must expressly engage agencies on any requisition. Agencies contacting hiring managers directly will not be tolerated, and doing so may impact your ability to work with 4DMT in the future.

4DMT is a leading late-stage biotechnology company advancing durable and disease-targeted therapeutics with potential to transform treatment paradigms and provide unprecedented benefits to patients. The Company’s lead product candidate 4D-150 is designed to be a backbone therapy forming the foundation of treatment of blinding retinal vascular diseases by providing multi-year sustained delivery of anti-VEGF (aflibercept and anti-VEGF-C) with a single, safe, intravitreal injection, which substantially reduces the treatment burden associated with current bolus injections. The Company’s lead indication for 4D-150 is wet age-related macular degeneration, which is currently in Phase 3 development, and second indication is diabetic macular edema. The Company’s second product candidate is 4D-710, which is the first known genetic medicine to demonstrate successful delivery and expression of the CFTR transgene in the lungs of people with cystic fibrosis after aerosol delivery

General Summary:

Vice President, Clinical Operations is responsible for strategic operational oversight and execution of one or more complex global clinical programs across the ophthalmology and/or broader portfolio. Reporting to the Chief Clinical Operations Officer, this role ensures clinical trials are planned and executed with excellence, delivering high-quality, inspection-ready data on time and within budget.

The VP provides leadership to Clinical Operations teams responsible for study execution and partners closely with cross-functional development teams, including Clinical Science, Medical, Regulatory, Data Sciences, Clinical Compliance, Quality, and Business Operations, to proactively identify and mitigate operational risks, optimize trial performance, and drive executional excellence across Phase 1–3 clinical development.

The VP fosters a culture of operational excellence by building scalable systems, standardized processes, and performance metrics that enable predictable execution, informed decision-making, and continuous improvement. This leader creates an environment where decisions are driven by objective data and operational metrics rather than individual effort.

Major Duties and Responsibilities:

Clinical Trial Execution & Oversight

  • Provide operational leadership and oversight for one or more large global clinical development programs or multiple phase 1-2 clinical studies from study start-up through database lock.
  • Ensure clinical trials are executed according to timelines, quality standards, budget, and corporate objectives.
  • Lead Clinical Operations teams to proactively identify risks, develop mitigation plans, and resolve operational challenges.
  • Ensure consistent execution of operational strategy across studies while maintaining inspection readiness.
  • Drive study performance through key operational metrics and continuous improvement initiatives.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Operations leaders (Senior Directors, Directors, CTMs) responsible for study execution.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Build organizational capability through coaching and talent development.

Cross-functional Leadership

  • Partner with Clinical Science, Regulatory, Data Sciences/Medical, Clinical Compliance, Quality, Pharmacovigilance, and Technical Operations to ensure seamless trial execution.
  • Represent Clinical Operations on cross-functional program teams.
  • Escalate critical operational issues and recommend solutions to executive leadership.

Vendor & Financial Oversight

  • Provide executive oversight of CROs and strategic vendors supporting assigned programs.
  • Partner with Clinical Compliance to establish and maintain risk-proportionate sponsor oversight of vendors and delegated trial activities, ensuring documented oversight processes, issue escalation, and continuous evaluation of performance and compliance.
  • Partner with Clinical Outsourcing and Business Operations to ensure vendor performance, governance, and accountability.
  • Oversee study budgets, forecasts, change orders, and resource planning.

Operational Excellence

  • Drive inspection readiness across assigned programs.
  • Ensure adherence to GCP, SOPs, regulatory requirements, and quality standards.
  • Develop and implement scalable operational processes and governance that improve execution efficiency, consistency, and inspection readiness.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics to proactively identify risks, measure performance, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Utilize data and performance analytics to support operational decision-making, resource planning, and study execution.
  • Drive a culture of operational excellence through standardization, accountability, and continuous process improvement.

Core Competencies

  • Demonstrated success leading execution of complex global Phase 1-3 clinical trials.
  • Proven ability to lead multiple Clinical Operations trial teams across concurrent programs.
  • Strong systems thinker with the ability to design scalable processes that support organizational growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage metrics, dashboards, and operational analytics to drive performance and informed decision-making.
  • Experience implementing process improvements that increase efficiency, quality, and execution predictability.
  • Ability to translate operational data into actionable insights and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience leading global CROs and strategic vendor partnerships.
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and organizational development skills.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Executive presence with concise communication and strong decision-making skills.
  • Deep knowledge of ICH-GCP, FDA, EMA, and global clinical trial regulations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific, business or health-related discipline.
  • 15+ years of Clinical Operations experience in biotechnology or pharmaceutical development.
  • Significant experience leading global Phase 1-2 and/or Phase 3 clinical trials.
  • Experience participating in regulatory authority inspections supporting global clinical development programs.
  • 6+ years of people leadership, including managing senior Clinical Operations leaders.
  • Ophthalmology (retina) clinical development experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success overseeing large global programs or multiple concurrent studies with significant operational complexity.

Travel: 5%

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Physical Requirements - Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.
  • Working Conditions - The worker is not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions (as in typical office or administrative work).

Base salary compensation range: $310,000 - $365,000

Please note, the base salary compensation range and actual salary offered to the final candidate depends on various factors: candidate’s geographical location, relevant work experience, skills, and years of experience.

4DMT provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, status as a covered veteran, and any other category protected under applicable federal, state, provincial and local laws.
Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

raw.description:
Key Account Manager, Metalworking Fluids (MWF)

Arxada is a global leader in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our groundbreaking technologies, in-depth regulatory know-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability. We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end-markets that include Human Health & Nutrition, Home & Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints & Coatings and Wood Protection. With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved 2 billion CHF in 2025 sales. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,100 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.[

As a Key Account Manager, Metalworking Fluids (MWF), you will play a critical role in accelerating growth across Arxada’s Material Protection business by developing strategic customer partnerships and delivering differentiated solutions to the global metalworking industry. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially driven professional with deep industry expertise to shape growth within a key market segment, influence portfolio strategy, and collaborate with talented global teams. You will combine technical credibility with commercial excellence to create value for customers, expand market share, and help drive sustainable, profitable growth across machining, forming, and industrial metalworking applications.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead execution of the Metalworking Fluids commercial strategy, delivering revenue, volume, and margin objectives across assigned global accounts and regions.
  • Build trusted relationships with strategic customers, including formulators, blenders, OEMs, and major industrial manufacturers, creating long-term partnerships and growth plans.
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities through account expansion, application development, value-selling initiatives, and market penetration strategies.
  • Partner closely with Product Management, Technical Service, R&D, Supply Chain, and Finance to deliver outstanding customer experiences and differentiated solutions.
  • Lead commercial and technical discussions covering metalworking performance requirements such as corrosion protection, lubricity, tool life, sustainability, and operational efficiency.
  • Drive disciplined pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, pricing execution, and CRM excellence while supporting profitable growth initiatives.
  • Monitor market trends, customer dynamics, competitive activity, and regulatory developments to identify strategic opportunities and inform business decisions.
  • Influence and collaborate across a matrix organization, providing leadership, guidance, and support to internal stakeholders and regional commercial teams.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 8+ years of progressive commercial experience within metalworking fluids, industrial lubricants, specialty chemicals, metal processing, or related industrial manufacturing sectors.
  • Proven track record of managing strategic accounts, leading complex negotiations, and delivering profitable growth.
  • Strong understanding of metalworking operations, machining processes, metal forming applications, OEM requirements, and manufacturing environments.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into compelling customer value propositions and commercial outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, negotiation, and strategic account planning skills.
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Dynamics, or equivalent systems.
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline preferred.
  • Willingness to travel internationally (approximately 30-50%) to support customers, projects, and business growth initiatives.

US Compensation Statement
The expected salary range for this role is 150-180k annually, but specific employee compensation may vary depending on factors including experience, education, training, licensure, certification, location and other job-related, non-discriminatory factors permitted by law.

This role is also eligible to earn a short-term incentive bonus and the following benefits: 401(k) plan, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, paid time off, paid holidays and paid sick leave.

Arxada has world class offering in two distinct areas:

Microbial Control Solutions (MCS) focuses on threats posed by microorganisms to people and planet through five distinct business lines including Professional Hygiene, Home & Personal Care, Wood Protection, Paints & Coatings and Material Protection. raw.description:
Position: Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations

Location: India

Schedule: 2pm - 11PM IST

About Us

HighLevel is a cloud-based, all-in-one white-label marketing and sales platform that empowers marketing agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, from marketing agencies to entrepreneurs to small businesses and beyond. Our platform empowers users across industries to streamline operations, drive growth, and crush their goals. HighLevel processes over 15 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million domain names.

Our People

With over 2000+ team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are:

You are a high-level strategic architect who combines rigorous analytical frameworks with deep tactical expertise to navigate HighLevel's most intricate workflows. Rather than overseeing static processes, you thrive on architecting the future of the organization. Your dual-track capabilities allow you to design long-range operational strategies while meticulously optimizing granular technical bottlenecks. You possess the executive presence to influence senior leadership through data-backed insights, fostering consensus across departments. Furthermore, you distinguish meaningful automated outcomes from mere deflection, maintaining a sharp focus on quantifiable success metrics.

What You’ll Be Doing:

STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP & LEADERSHIP ALIGNMENT

You are the embedded RevOps partner and strategic advisor to Support leadership. Your mandate is to make the Support organization more effective by owning the operational and analytical layer that connects their work to business outcomes.

  • Partner with the Sr. Director of RevOps and Support leadership to lead annual and quarterly planning — building bottoms-up operational plans grounded in real capacity drivers and demand signals
  • Own forecasting frameworks for the Support organization — ticket volume projections, channel mix trends, resolution capacity, and cost-per-resolution modeling
  • Track actuals against plan with discipline — identify deviations early, understand root causes, and bring forward-looking recommendations rather than backward-looking reports
  • Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews for Support leadership — owning the narrative, surfacing strategic gaps, and driving prioritized action
  • Build the financial models and business cases that support investment decisions — new tooling, AI capability expansions, channel investments, and headcount planning
  • Challenge assumptions with data — if Support leadership is making prioritization decisions based on instinct or anecdote, your job is to stress-test them with rigour and evidence

BUSINESS IMPACT FRAMEWORK — CONNECTING SUPPORT TO REVENUE OUTCOMES

This is one of the most strategically important mandates in this role. Support at HighLevel operates at scale — but the connection between support quality and the business outcomes that matter most (customer retention, lifetime value, churn) has not been formally built. You will build it.

  • Design and own the analytical framework that connects Support activity and quality to downstream customer outcomes — retention rates, churn signals, and customer lifetime value
  • Quantify the business impact of Support at the leadership level — translating operational metrics into revenue and retention outcomes that resonate at the executive level
  • Build the early warning system that gives Support leadership visibility into customer health signals emerging through support interactions — before they become retention problems
  • Identify where recurring ticket patterns reveal product gaps, friction points, or customer experience failures — and surface structured findings to Product and GTM leaders with clear business impact framing
  • Feed Support intelligence into the broader GTM customer lifecycle analytics layer, in partnership with the GTM Strategy function
  • Establish Support as a strategic contributor to retention decisions — not just an operational function measured on speed and volume

SUPPORT OPERATIONS — PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT & ANALYTICS

The Support organization runs a sophisticated tiered operation across multiple channels and time zones. Building the RevOps layer that gives leadership real-time operational intelligence is a core deliverable of this role.

  • Own the KPI framework for the Support organization — defining what good looks like across CSAT, turnaround time, resolution quality, first contact resolution, escalation rates, and tier distribution
  • Build and maintain the analytics infrastructure that gives Support leadership visibility into team and channel performance at the granularity they need to make operational decisions
  • Track performance across L1, L2, and L3 tiers — identifying where escalation patterns reveal training gaps, process breakdowns, or product complexity issues
  • Own channel performance analytics — how are ticket volumes, resolution rates, and customer satisfaction scores distributed across chat, platform, and live Zoom channels, and what does the optimal channel mix look like
  • Build cost efficiency models — cost per resolution, cost by channel, cost by tier — enabling leadership to make evidence-based decisions about where to invest and where to optimize
  • Design and govern the operating cadences that keep Support leadership aligned, informed, and action-oriented — weekly business reviews, performance reviews, and escalation governance

AI & AUTOMATION — STRATEGIC OPERATIONS

HighLevel has deployed AI-assisted support tooling that is already delivering meaningful results at scale. This role is responsible for ensuring that investment continues to grow in impact — not just in volume.

  • Own the RevOps operational layer for the Support AI bot — tracking deflection performance, measuring impact on customer satisfaction and resolution quality, and identifying where AI is creating gaps versus solving them
  • Build the measurement framework that distinguishes between AI deflection (a ticket was not raised) and AI resolution (a customer's problem was actually solved) — and track both with rigour
  • Work with the AI/Innovation team on continuous improvement priorities — bringing structured operational findings, edge cases, and quality gaps that should inform the next phase of AI capability development
  • Identify where automation can reduce manual operational overhead within the Support RevOps function itself — and implement those automations proactively
  • Partner with the AI/Innovation team on the roadmap for Support AI expansion — providing the operational intelligence and requirements that should shape future AI investments

Process Design, Systems & Data Infrastructure

  • Audit and redesign operational workflows across the Support organization — from ticket routing and triage logic to escalation pathways and resolution standards
  • Define and govern handoff standards between Support tiers and between Support and other GTM functions — ensuring customers do not fall through the cracks as they move between channels and teams
  • Design process documentation standards for the Support organization — every key workflow should be documented, version-controlled, and accessible
  • Lead change management for new processes and systems — adoption is the measure of success, not design
  • Identify and eliminate operational redundancies — the Support organization operates at a scale where small inefficiencies compound significantly
  • Partner with the RevOps systems team and the AI/Innovation team to ensure the Support organization has the tools, data pipelines, and automation infrastructure it needs to operate at scale
  • Own data integrity for the Support organization — clean metric definitions, consistent tagging and categorization, and reliable reporting pipelines across all support platforms
  • Define requirements for tooling investments — translating operational needs into clear specifications for build vs. buy decisions

What You’ll Bring:

  • Possess exceptional analytical rigor with the ability to engineer complex fiscal models, operational frameworks, and bottom-line impact evaluations from the ground up
  • Act as a strategic visionary possessing deep tactical expertise, capable of architecting long-range directions while simultaneously mastering granular execution
  • Demonstrate the executive presence required to influence senior leadership, leveraging data-driven skepticism to foster institutional alignment and challenge status-quo assumptions
  • Deep experience navigating sophisticated service-centric ecosystems and omnichannel engagement platforms such as Freshdesk, Zoom, or similar enterprise solutions
  • Proficient in optimizing AI-driven automation workflows, maintaining a sharp focus on distinguishing verified problem resolution from superficial ticket deflection
  • Instinctively proactive, with a disciplined approach to surfacing critical operational trends and risks before they escalate into urgent bottlenecks
  • Exceptional people leader dedicated to cultivating high-performing analyst cohorts through extreme ownership, rigorous standards, and strategic foresight
  • Thrive within institutional ambiguity, possessing the architect’s mindset to transform unstructured challenges into scalable, high-fidelity organizational structures

Experience/Education/Certifications Required:

  • Possess 10+ years of professional trajectory within Revenue, Support, or Customer Success Operations, demonstrating significant mastery in managing high-volume, client-centric GTM ecosystems
  • Tier-1 MBA or a background in management consulting is highly preferred, emphasizing the analytical rigor required to engineer solutions for complex operational bottlenecks and engage leadership with executive clarity
  • Proven architect who has designed and scaled support operations infrastructure within expansive, enterprise-grade environments from the ground up
  • Deep expertise in establishing the causal nexus between service excellence metrics and quantifiable bottom-line outcomes like customer retention and revenue health
  • Operational mastery of AI-driven automation workflows, with a disciplined focus on verifying resolution throughput, quality auditing, and deflection efficacy
  • Significant experience navigating high-velocity SaaS landscapes where scaling requires the ability to architect robust frameworks while managing real-time institutional ambiguity
  • Formal certifications are secondary to a documented history of driving high-fidelity organizational impact and strategic foresight

Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. raw.description:
Global Payroll Specialist

Assembled Intelligence is comprised of Minds+Assembly, BOLDSCIENCE, and Stratevi with a presence in the US and UK.

The Payroll Specialist at Assembled Intelligence will play a critical role in ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing for all entities and regions. Primarily this position will work in collaboration with the Associate Director, Global Payroll and Benefits.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

The Global Payroll Specialist will assist with the execution of payroll operations for the global workforce. The role includes onboarding employees for payroll purposes, processing payroll, ensuring compliance with various state, federal, and HMRC regulations, and managing detailed reporting. This role requires balancing meticulous attention to detail with the ability to identify and implement process improvements in a growing organization. In general, the Payroll Specialist will:

Payroll Operations:

  • Onboard employees across the United States and United Kingdom, ensuring compliance with country specific payroll, tax, and statutory documentation requirements.
  • Maintains accurate employee records and coordinates all necessary setup activities to support seamless and compliant payroll processing.
  • Process bi-weekly, semi-monthly, and monthly payrolls across multiple entities with multiple states and the UK ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery.
    • Manage and process payroll inputs, including regular earnings, bonuses, and deductions (e.g., benefits, garnishments).
    • Reconcile payroll prior to transmission to ensure all adjustments and changes are accurately reflected.
  • Establish new accounts for Withholding, SUI, and Local taxes as needed.
  • Collaborate with other stakeholders to update employee records, pay rates, and other relevant data.
  • Maintain a workflow with other members of the People+ Team to ensure all types of leave (such as maternity, paternity, leave without pay, etc.) which impact payroll is executed correctly.

Time Off Management:

  • Administer employee vacation, sick leave, and other paid time off accruals in accordance with company policies.
  • Perform regular audits to ensure time-off balances are accurately calculated and communicated.

Compliance and Regulations:

  • Maintain compliance with applicable US federal, state, and local payroll laws and UK payroll regulations, including wage and hour requirements, tax reporting, statutory payments, employee deductions, pension administration, and other payroll-related compliance obligations.
  • Remain current on payroll, tax, leave, and employment law developments across the United States and United Kingdom, with a focus on states and jurisdictions that have unique regulatory requirements, ensuring payroll practices remain compliant and aligned with applicable legislation.
  • Assist with responding to inquiries from tax agencies as needed.

Reporting and Analysis:

  • Support financial audits and reconciliations by preparing detailed payroll documentation and addressing inquiries.
  • Collaborate with the Finance team to reconcile payroll and resolve discrepancies.
  • Ability to create and deliver Ad Hoc reports as requested by Senior Leadership.

System Management:

  • Utilize Dayforce and other benefit systems to manage employee records, support payroll transactions, and ensure data accuracy for employees across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Collaborate on system implementations, upgrades, testing, and integrations to optimize payroll, benefits, and time-off processes and improve operational efficiency.

Excel Expertise:

  • Create and maintain complex spreadsheets and reporting tools to support payroll calculations, reconciliations, audits, and compliance reporting.
  • Utilize Excel knowledge and data analysis techniques to manage large datasets, validate payroll information, identify discrepancies, and improve reporting efficiency.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of relevant payroll experience, preferably in a multi-state or global organization
  • A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as accounting or business administration is preferred
  • Strong understanding of US and UK payroll legislation, tax regulations, and compliance requirements, including federal, state, local, and statutory payroll obligations.
  • Proficiency in Dayforce Payroll and HCM, with experience supporting multi-jurisdiction payroll operations, maintaining data integrity, and generating payroll, compliance, and workforce reports.
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills
  • High level of attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex payroll concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while taking initiative to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
  • Highly motivated, decisive, solution- and results-oriented with flexibility and creativity to excel in a rapidly growing and changing environment

raw.excerpt: Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide.
raw.description:
Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Houston’s fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in Healthcare & Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025.

Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we’ve created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

POSITION SUMMARY

Empower is seeking a Staff QA Automation Engineer to serve as the enterprise technical authority for quality engineering, driving the architecture, governance, and evolution of scalable automation capabilities across the organization. This role owns the long-term strategy for automation frameworks, testing practices, and quality engineering standards that improve software reliability, accelerate delivery, and enable data-driven decision making. Leveraging AI as a force multiplier, the Staff QA Automation Engineer advances automation speed, scale, quality, and engineering productivity through intelligent tooling, predictive insights, and reusable platform capabilities. Operating with significant autonomy, this role influences engineering strategy across Empower's hyper-growth, highly regulated 503A and 503B environment, partnering with technology leaders to solve complex technical challenges while demonstrating exceptional strategic thinking, execution rigor, innovation, and continuous learning agility.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Automation Strategy

  • Framework Ownership: Own the technical architecture, governance, and multi-year roadmap for Empower's enterprise automation ecosystem, ensuring scalable, reusable, and maintainable capabilities across UI, API, performance, accessibility, visual, and end-to-end testing. Leverage AI-assisted engineering, predictive analytics, and emerging automation technologies to accelerate framework evolution, improve engineering efficiency, and establish enterprise-wide quality engineering standards that support long-term business growth.
  • Architecture Design: Define automation architecture and quality engineering strategy for new platforms, products, and enterprise initiatives before implementation begins. Establish scalable design patterns, reusable framework components, and engineering standards that enable consistent automation practices while improving delivery speed, software quality, maintainability, and cross-team collaboration throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Technology Innovation: Evaluate, pilot, and introduce emerging automation technologies, including AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, intelligent test optimization, and next-generation observability solutions. Continuously assess industry trends to modernize engineering capabilities, improve execution quality, reduce maintenance effort, and position Empower's automation ecosystem for future scalability.

Technical Excellence

  • Framework Standards: Architect reusable framework components including Page Objects, API clients, authentication utilities, fixtures, reporting modules, test data management, and validation libraries that establish consistent engineering patterns across teams. Define coding standards, documentation, and governance processes that improve automation quality, maintainability, scalability, and long-term platform sustainability.
  • Validation Strategy: Define enterprise strategies for API contract validation, response schema verification, database validation, Salesforce integration testing, and cross-platform data integrity. Resolve highly complex integration challenges while establishing repeatable validation methodologies that improve confidence in application behavior, data accuracy, and enterprise system reliability.
  • Performance Engineering: Lead enterprise performance testing strategy using modern load testing frameworks, establishing methodologies for capacity planning, scalability assessment, stress testing, spike testing, and production readiness. Apply AI-driven analytics and performance intelligence to identify bottlenecks, predict capacity risks, and support informed architectural decisions before release.

Platform Reliability

  • Pipeline Optimization: Own the technical health, architecture, scalability, and reliability of automated execution pipelines across Azure DevOps, GitHub, Docker, and cloud environments. Continuously optimize execution performance through automation, intelligent orchestration, AI-assisted diagnostics, and resilient engineering practices that improve deployment confidence and reduce operational risk.
  • Quality Visibility: Define enterprise reporting strategies integrating Jira, Xray, Allure, Microsoft Teams, Prometheus, Grafana, and other engineering platforms to deliver trusted quality metrics and actionable operational insights. Ensure automation results provide meaningful visibility that supports leadership decision-making, release readiness, and continuous improvement across engineering organizations.
  • Root Cause: Lead investigation of the organization's most complex automation failures, pipeline instability, flaky tests, performance degradation, and integration issues. Drive systemic engineering improvements by identifying underlying technical causes, implementing durable architectural solutions, and eliminating recurring quality risks rather than applying temporary fixes.

Technical Leadership

  • Engineering Governance: Establish enterprise-wide automation governance through technical reviews, engineering standards, architectural guidance, and quality engineering best practices. Influence engineering decisions across multiple teams while ensuring consistent implementation of scalable automation patterns that strengthen software quality and accelerate product delivery.
  • Technical Mentorship: Mentor senior and mid-level quality engineers by providing technical coaching, architectural guidance, and expert support for the organization's most challenging automation initiatives. Foster engineering excellence through knowledge sharing, design reviews, and continuous development that elevates technical capability across the quality engineering function.
  • Strategic Partnership: Partner with engineering leadership, architects, product management, DevOps, and cross-functional stakeholders to align automation strategy with business objectives, product roadmaps, and technology investments. Represent quality engineering in architectural planning while communicating automation value, engineering metrics, AI adoption strategies, and return on investment to executive leadership.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Expert knowledge of enterprise test automation architecture, quality engineering principles, and modern software development practices, with advanced proficiency in Playwright, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, API automation, CI/CD, and scalable automation framework design.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate and implement AI-assisted engineering capabilities, predictive quality analytics, self-healing automation, and intelligent test optimization that improve engineering productivity, software quality, decision-making, and enterprise scalability.
  • Advanced expertise in performance engineering, API contract validation, cloud-based development platforms, Git workflows, Azure DevOps, GitHub, SQL, enterprise integrations, and observability technologies, with the ability to solve highly complex technical challenges across distributed systems.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, technical leadership, communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills, with the ability to influence architecture decisions, establish enterprise engineering standards, build organizational consensus, and drive continuous improvement across multiple cross-functional teams.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and progressive professional experience in software quality engineering, automation architecture, or software development.
  • Twelve (12) or more years of progressive experience in software quality assurance, test automation, quality engineering, or software development in test, including demonstrated success leading enterprise automation strategy, architecting scalable frameworks, and influencing technical direction across multiple engineering teams without direct authority.
  • Extensive hands-on experience designing enterprise automation frameworks using Playwright, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js, with deep expertise in UI, API, integration, regression, end-to-end, contract, and performance testing, CI/CD pipeline architecture, cloud-native engineering practices, and enterprise system integrations.
  • Preferred experience includes designing enterprise automation platforms from inception, implementing AI-assisted testing technologies, accessibility automation, containerized execution, cloud platforms, healthcare or other regulated industries, and industry-recognized certifications such as ISTQB Advanced or Expert Level, Test Automation Engineer, Microsoft Azure, AWS, GitHub, Salesforce, Agile, or DevOps professional certifications.

Key Competencies:

  • Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
  • Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
  • Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
  • Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
  • Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
  • Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
  • Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

Values:

  • People: Empowering people defines who we are.
  • Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
  • Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
  • Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

Employee Benefits, Health and Wellness:

We offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, well-being, and future, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, 401(k) matching, wellness perks, IV therapy, and compounded medications. Learn more:

Physical Requirements:

While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to talk and hear. The employee is often required to remain in a stationary position for a significant amount of the workday and frequently use their hands and fingers to handle or feel in order to access, input, and retrieve information from the computer and other office productivity devices. Employees are regularly required to move about the office and around the corporate campus. The employee is regularly required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

raw.description:
Join the People Helping People

Velera is the nation’s premier payments credit union service organization (CUSO) and an integrated fintech solutions provider. The company serves more than 4,000 financial institutions throughout North America, operating with velocity to help our clients keep pace with the rapid momentum of change and fuel growth in the new era of financial services. Our purpose: We accelerate partners’ success through innovative financial technology solutions and inspired service.

The Opportunity

The Accounts Payable Specialist will review and enter vendor invoices, perform basic trending analyses, interact with various departments and management, and ensure payments are made timely and in compliance with corporate policy. The AP Specialist will also provide support during month-end close as it pertains to AP trend review, invoice pulls, expense accruals, prepaid support, and all other items requested by the accounting team.

Day in the Life

  • Processes and audits invoices for payment, including approvals and coding to the appropriate cost center and general ledger account in accordance with the company policies and procedures.

  • Responsible for processing payments weekly, as well as submitting remittances to vendors.

  • Responsible for saving all invoices and related support electronically in compliance with record retention policies.

  • Keeps track of credits owed to the company and ensures all credits are properly applied to vendor payments.

  • Resolve invoice discrepancies and issues promptly.

  • Reconciles payable reports each month to confirm that all amounts paid were accurate.

  • Responsible for submitting new vendor/supplier packet to leadership for Oracle setup, including, but not limited to: contract summary, W9 form, ACH form, approval from VMO and/or Procurement, etc.

  • Assists in preparation of annual 1099 forms.

  • Responds to all inquiries in a timely, professional, and efficient manner.

  • Assists with canceled payments, voided checks, and stop payments along with any required research.

  • Assists with providing support for year-end audit.

  • Assists with obtaining information for necessary accruals related to operational expenses in which an invoice has not yet been received.

  • Assists with operational reporting metrics for A/P and vendor spend.

  • Ability to work, adapt and be productive in a flexible environment .

  • Assists in the monthly review of the AP trend analysis report for month-end close.

  • Responsible for mailing checks in a timely manner.

  • All other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Completion of high school or equivalent.

  • Minimum of two years accounts payable experience.

The Agent Architect is a technical leader responsible for designing and building autonomous AI workflows (“agents”) that drive measurable ROI for clients. This role bridges the gap between high-level business goals and technical execution, ensuring that AI demo environments and client trials are configured for maximum success.

Reports to: Director of Customer Success

Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection. Driven by our mission to protect, manage and automate every workload, we’ve built the industry’s only all-in-one solution.

Based in LATAM, the Cloud Sales Advisor, reporting to the regional Cloud Sales Manager, will drive revenue growth by identifying, qualifying, and closing new service provider partnerships in North America. You will manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiation and contract closure, while collaborating closely with internal teams and distribution partners. This role requires a hunter mentality, strong communication skills, and a deep understanding of the cloud computing landscape.

* Please send your CV's in english. Thank you!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Attract new Service Providers to Acronis by reaching out to prospects that have already engaged with Acronis through offline/online events, registered for trial, opened Acronis emails, etc.

  • Source new Service Providers prospects via LinkedIn, Salesforce database, connections.

  • Connect with Acronis potential Service Providers using the approved tools, including but not limited to Avaya, Zoom, Outlook, etc. to verify the interest level based on certain criteria and BANT qualification, such as: the environment, need, budget, pain points, competitors, decision makers, number of workloads they want to protect.

  • All activities must be documented in Salesforce, demo sessions via Zoom should be done with camera on.

  • Do the research before reaching out to a prospect and prepare questions based on it, using company’s web site, LinkedIn profile, any other public information about the company or contact

  • Manage the whole sales cycle: qualification, negotiation, demo sessions with the involvement of the Solution Engineers if needed, negotiating, closing the deal by signing a contract offline or online

  • Make sure to sign a contract with quality Service Providers, who are ready to invest into the business with Acronis and plan to stay for a long time

  • Manage the pipeline: maintain Service Level to follow-up prospects, provide timely forecast to direct Manager or regional General Manager

  • Align and sync with Distributors in the assigned region, including bi-weekly calls, joint marketing activities and events

  • Co-operate with all related departments at Acronis to close the deal successfully: Solution Engineers, Support, Sales Enablement, Product Management, etc.

  • Understand Acronis brand messages and communicate them effectively to prospects; respect and support sales' role in promoting a positive brand image

  • Understand Acronis key competitors and effectively communicate differentiators ("kill points") of our products/solutions

  • Receive coaching feedback and participate in individual coaching sessions

  • Pass obligatory quarterly upskill training sessions

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 3+ years sales experience as Inside Sales Representative or Lead Development Representative

  • Proven experience in a Cyber Security company demonstrating a strong understanding of industry practices and protocols is required

  • Ability to articulate product’s different features, and answers any questions customers might have

  • Have strong closing sales skills

  • Have good english language skills

  • Experience with cold calling is preferred with a never give up attitude

WHO WE ARE

A Swiss company foundedin Singapore in2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and more than 1800 employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 20,000 service providers to protect over 750,000 businesses.

Our corporate culture centers on innovation, accountability, and impact. We encourage our people to think boldly, challenge conventional approaches, and take ownership of outcomes. As a member of our global “A-Team,”you’lloperatein a high-growth, fast-paced environment where resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement drive success.

OUR INTERVIEW PRACTICES

To ensure a fair and genuine hiring process, candidates are expected toparticipatein interviews without the use of AI tools, automated prompts, or third-partyassistance. Interviews are designed to assess individual skills, experience, and communicationstyle,and we value authentic, real-time interaction.

Use of AI or externalassistanceduring live interviews may result in disqualification. For roles where AI skills are being evaluated,permitteduse of AI tools will be clearly communicated in advance. Candidates may be asked to disable virtual backgrounds orparticipatein in-person interviews. All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of applicable criminal,educationand identity background checks

Acronis is an equalopportunityemployer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

The US pay range for this position is $89,000–$120,000. This range reflects the minimum and maximum total target annual compensation for this role across all U.S. locations. The actual compensation offered at the start of employment is determined based on factors including, but not limited to, experience level, knowledge, skills, and geographic location.

In addition to competitive compensation, this role includes a comprehensive benefits package featuring medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending accounts (FSA), disability and life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan with company match, and a generous vacation policy.

raw.description:
Description

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: hosts the group live events, reviews the work, runs the solution design and delivery reviews, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside you. The curriculum is built by a team of senior authors.

This is a teaching and reviewing role. You'll be the senior technical presence students learn from week to week. You'll run group live events, give real engineering feedback on student deployment deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

Format: Group live events, 1:1s, and workshops timed around US Eastern Time – mostly 2:00 PM to 9:00 PM ET. Estimated 5 to 15 hrs/week.

Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

What you will do

  • Host live events focused on deploying AI systems inside a client's environment: discovery and scoping, agentic architecture, integration with enterprise systems, rollout, and adoption.
  • Run 1:1 sessions and tech mock interviews for students working through projects.
  • Review student projects against rubrics, including the client-facing side of the work: scoping decisions, demos, and how they explain a system to a non-technical stakeholder.
  • Set the technical standard for a team of supporting instructors who cover questions and first-line review, and act as their escalation point.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).
  • Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments – first call through production go-live and adoption.
  • Depth across the FDE spine: customer discovery and design sessions, scoping and delivery planning under ambiguity, stakeholder management without formal authority; LLM and agent systems in production (prompting, tool/function calling, orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph/LangChain/CrewAI, guardrails, evals, RAG over enterprise data); APIs and integrations (REST, webhooks, JSON/GraphQL), Python, and deployment on at least one major cloud.
  • Can explain why an architecture or scoping decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's work live.
  • Strong technical communication: translating between technical and business audiences, comfortable leading a live session, whiteboarding a solution, and writing clear, specific review feedback.
  • Strong English C1+ — instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience.
  • Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work.

Preferred experience:

  • Has taught, mentored, or run technical sessions before: internal tech talks, onboarding, mentoring engineers, bootcamp or workshop instruction.
  • Has worked embedded within a customer team as their primary technical resource, or held a customer-facing engineering role (solutions engineer, solutions architect, technical consultant).
  • Production experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI) and MCP-based tool integrations into client systems.
  • Work experience at a recognizable company.
  • Familiarity with online education platforms or running programs.

What we can offer you

  • Fully remote work, with live sessions scheduled within US afternoon and evening hours.
  • A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
  • Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
  • A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

raw.title: Product Engineer (Contract)
raw.excerpt: There is a working product.  There is one founder.
raw.description:
There is a working product. There is one founder. There is no team yet.

The product needs someone to take it the rest of the way — finish the build, harden it, test it, put it in front of the first real users, and stay close enough to those users to know what to fix next.

That's the job. It is not a well-defined ticket queue. It's closer to: here is the thing, here is what "done" means, go.

This is a paid contract role. We're paying for your time and your expertise, and we expect to pay properly for both.

What we're building

An orchestration layer that sits above the frontier AI models — Claude, GPT, Gemini — and coordinates them rather than picking one.

It is aimed at people whose work product is judgment, where being wrong is expensive and "the AI said so" is not an acceptable answer.

Where things actually stand

  • The core product works end to end.
  • There's a real documentation and decision-log discipline in place — architecture invariants, contracts, a decision record going back months, git hooks enforcing some of it. You will not be reverse-engineering a mystery.
  • There are known open bugs, known unfinished surfaces, and a UI that needs an aesthetics pass.
  • It has never had a user who wasn't the founder.

The gap between "works" and "someone else can use this without me sitting next to them" is the gap you're being hired to close.

What you'd own

Phase 1 — Close it out (first weeks)

  • Finish the remaining feature work; hide or cut what isn't ready
  • Aesthetics and UX pass — it needs to feel like a product, not a prototype
  • Fix the open bug list; expand test coverage
  • Security hardening pass ahead of real users (external review budgeted separately — you'll work with it, not carry it alone)

Phase 2 — Alpha

  • Ship it to real users
  • Onboarding: get people from signup to first genuine use without hand-holding
  • Support them directly. You'll be answering the emails. This is a feature of the job, not a chore attached to it.
  • Instrument it enough to know what people actually do, versus what they say they do

Phase 3 — Beta and beyond

  • Turn alpha behaviour into the beta roadmap
  • Help make the call on who this ships to first: individual professionals, small firms, or enterprise
  • Build the systems and documentation that let a bigger team pick this up later

Stack

  • Frontend: vanilla JS, HTML, CSS — a single-file monolith, no framework. Deliberate. It'll be broken up when there's a reason, not before.
  • Backend: Supabase (Postgres, auth, storage)
  • Hosting: Netlify, deploy on push
  • Provider APIs: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google
  • Node for tooling and tests

If you need a framework to be effective, this isn't your project. If reading 5,000 lines of someone else's JavaScript and immediately knowing where the bodies are buried sounds fine, keep reading.

Who we're looking for

Someone who uses both sides of their brain.

One side reads code carefully. Spots the branch that swallows an error without telling anyone. Doesn't trust a function just because of its name. Can hold the whole system in their head and work out what a change will break three files away.

The other side thinks about the person on the other side of the screen. Why they gave up at step three. Which feature they'll ask for and never use. What would make them tell a colleague about this.

Most people are good at one. We want someone who is genuinely strong on the code side and has real instinct for the user side — someone who can look at a screen and say "this works, and nobody will use it," and be right.

Hard requirement: you have shipped something real inside an agentic coding harness.

We mean you have worked inside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Aider, or something equivalent — as your main development environment — and something you built that way exists, runs, and has been used by someone other than you. You know how these tools fail. You know what they'll confidently get wrong. You've built your own habits around checking what they produce, because you've been burned by not doing it.

Using AI to look things up or to explain code is not the same thing, and isn't what we're asking about.

And you finish things. One small project that shipped, got users, and was supported for months tells us more than ten impressive repos that stopped at 80%. We're being direct about this because the failure mode of this role is a beautiful, elaborate, unlaunched product.

What we are not asking for

  • A degree, or a degree in progress, or a degree completed
  • A specific number of years. Second-year student and twenty-five-year veteran are both entirely welcome, and will be assessed identically.
  • A recognisable logo on your CV
  • Deep security or infrastructure specialisation — that's brought in as expertise where it's needed
  • Prior startup experience

The founder covers strategy, product direction, positioning, and go-to-market. What's missing is build capacity and someone who owns getting it in front of users.

Hard requirement: you've shipped something real inside an agentic harness — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Aider. As your actual dev environment, not as a lookup tool. And someone other than you has used what you built.

Don't care about your degree, your years, or your logos. Student or twenty-year veteran, same bar.

Stack: vanilla JS single-file monolith, Supabase, Netlify. No framework. If that sounds fine, we should talk.

Full-time, 40 hours a week, remote, with overlap into US morning or evening hours. Two months to start, with the possibility to continue.

To apply, send me one thing you shipped with an agentic harness, whether anyone else ever used it, and — in five lines — the first three things you'd do with a working product and zero users.

Send an email with:

  1. One thing you shipped using an agentic coding harness. Link to it, live if possible. Tell us which harness, what it got wrong, and how you caught it.

  2. Whether anyone other than you ever used it — how many people, for how long, and what broke when they did.

  3. Five lines, no more: you've just been handed a working product with zero users. What are the first three things you do?

  4. One thing you've killed. A feature, a project, an approach you'd invested real time in and cut anyway. Why.

No cover letter. No CV unless you want to send one. We're reading for judgment, not formatting.

Shortlisted candidates get a full walkthrough of what's been built, followed by a coding interview.

Terms

  • Engagement: Contract
  • Commitment: Full-time, 40 hours per week
  • Duration: 2 months, starting immediately, with the possibility to continue
  • Location: Remote. Overlap with US morning and/or evening hours required.

This is for a US start up.

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

About the Role

You’ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.

Responsibilities:

  • Invent a realistic developer scenario — a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature — not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands — deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20–60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors’ tasks as a QA reviewer.

Not in scope

  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship — you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles — scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships — quality over quantity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack — Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency — required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring — reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux & Bash — comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience — Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English — B2+ written.

Not a fit

  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.

Process

Apply → Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid.

Time commitment

  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2–4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8–20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.

Compensation:

  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour*.
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.

*Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

Apply

Submit your CV via the Mindrift platform. Indicate your English level, note this role (Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist — Terminal Bench), and include a GitHub profile link if available.

SUMMARY

The Senior IT Systems Administrator is responsible for the advanced administration/configuration, security, performance, report management/analytics, and optimization of enterprise financial and non-clinical applications. This role acts as a technical lead and trusted partner to Finance, Operations and IT leadership, ensuring financial/non-clinical systems are secure, reliable, compliant, and aligned with business needs.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provided knowledge support of new system design, functional requirement and work/data flows supporting the system implementation process.
  • Administer, configure, and support enterprise financial systems (ERP, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting platforms).
  • Manage system environments (production, test, development), upgrades, patches, and release cycles.
  • Working with operations and finance staff, development of workflow / system optimization planning to ensure the continued automation of workflows and system maturity.
  • Monitor system performance, availability, and integrations; resolve complex system issues.
  • Works directly with financial staff/leaders to draft detailed report/analytics requirements to support organizational / departmental financial reporting / analytics.
  • Security, Controls & Compliance: Design and maintain role-based security, user provisioning, and access controls, ensure compliance with SOX, internal controls, audit standards, and organizational policies, support internal and external audits by providing system documentation and access evidence.
  • Integrations & Enhancements: Lead integrations between financial/ERP/non-clinical systems and upstream/downstream applications, partner with vendors and internal IT teams on system enhancements, new modules, and implementations, lead system testing, validation, and change management efforts.
  • Data Integrity & Reporting Support: Ensure system data accuracy, consistency, and reconciliation across systems, support Finance with reporting, analytics, data extracts, and troubleshooting, identify and resolve root causes of data and interface issues.
  • Leadership & Process Improvement: Serve as a technical subject matter expert and escalation point, mentor junior administrators and establish system administration best practices, working with financial staff and leaders, identifies and implement process improvements to increase automation and efficiency.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or related field.
  • 5 years of experience administering enterprise financial or ERP systems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration abilities
  • High attention to detail and commitment to system reliability.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Experience with financial planning, consolidation, or reporting tools (Hyperion, Anaplan, Adaptive, OneStream).
  • Strong hands-on experience with platforms such as MS Dynamics, SAP, Oracle, Workday, PeopleSoft, or similar.

  • Experience with SQL, reporting tools (MS Power BI, SPSS, Crystal Reports, etc.) , integrations, APIs, or middleware tools.
  • Relevant certifications: Dynamics 365 Business Central / MS Power BI.
  • Experience with cloud security.

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS:

L - Light Work - Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly; requires occasional walking, standing or squatting.

For disease specific care programs refer to the program specific requirements of the department for further specifications on experience and educational expectations, including continuing education requirements.

Any physical requirements reported by a prospective employee and/or employee’s physician or delegate will be considered for accommodations.

Vencora Business Unit:

Job Summary:

Job Description Summary
Reporting into the Senior Manager of Corporate Development, the Business Development Associate will be responsible for representing the front-end of Vencora's acquisition activities—establishing contacts, building, and nurturing relationships with CEOs and owners of global companies. Our focus is to build a strong portfolio of businesses that are specialists in their own market.

Job Description:

What You Will Be Doing

You will drive our acquisition activities of sourcing and nurturing target companies by:

  • Creatively identifying leads for vertical market software businesses meeting our strategic criteria and specific metrics
  • Maintaining and building a proprietary database of industry contacts
  • Developing and conducting prospecting campaigns through digital media, outbound cold calling, email sequences, in-person meetings, and industry events
  • Consistently making direct outreach to business owners and executives, confidently navigating gatekeepers, and initiating compelling conversations
  • Demonstrating creativity, persistence, and credibility in reaching out to Owners, Operators, and C-Suite leadership
  • Gathering target company information and qualifying opportunities for potential acquisition
  • Presenting high-potential opportunities to the internal M&A team and supporting progression to NDA or deeper evaluation
  • Traveling to attend tradeshows, prospecting trips, and in-person meetings as needed (up to 20%)

Skills You Will Bring

We are looking for someone who is driven, results-oriented, and unafraid to pick up the phone. You have excellent interpersonal skills, strong business instincts, and a proactive mindset. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are motivated by building relationships and sourcing great businesses.

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent academic performance in an undergraduate business degree. A master’s degree from a top-tier school is a plus
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. Fluency in English is necessary
  • Demonstrated success with cold calling and outbound prospecting—you are confident initiating conversations with founders and C-level executives and know how to get past gatekeepers
  • 4+ years of experience in a business development, lead generation, or outbound sales role, ideally in a B2B or M&A environment
  • Ability to manage a pipeline of leads and consistently exceed outreach and engagement targets
