raw.description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Digital Marketing Project Manager will play an integral part in the overall success of our account team’s delivery and service to our clients, serving as the communications and coordinating hub between team members and the client. This role will report directly into the Client Experience team,, and will be supported by Power’s Project Management Office (PMO).

This role will be an exceptional client-facing project manager, skilled at managing and delivering digital marketing deliverables and solutions from inception to completion. They will become part of a high-performing team that gets client deliverables completed on time, on budget and with the highest standards of quality while working in a dynamic, fast-paced and forward thinking agency environment. Working closely with clients and account teams, this role will manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines and multi-disciplinary teams to meet our client’s strategic and tactical marketing objectives. As a key member of the account team, this role will be proactive, have excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and be confident in your ability to meticulously organize and keep your deliverables moving forward on-time without compromising quality. They will keep all stakeholders up to date with progress and overcoming all of the inevitable challenges along the way.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines, deliverables and cross-functional team members via web-based project management software (Asana) and various communication channels
  • Create and execute deliverable plans, and revise as appropriate to meet continuously changing needs and requirements
  • Oversee all aspects of deliverable management: scope, risk, schedule, quality, and communication to stakeholders’ fullest satisfaction
  • Support account calls through detailed recaps, captured action items, Asana task assignments and diligent follow-up on action items
  • Evaluate new work requests, identify resources needed, assign individual responsibilities, and schedule action items
  • Provide regular updates and progress reports to internal teams and/or client stakeholders
  • Conduct risk management and escalate internally within the account team to proactively mitigate issues
  • Identify areas for improvement with internal and external processes along with possible solutions

Role Requirements:

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience leading projects and supporting client deliverables in a digital marketing agency environment
  • Strong proficiency with Asana as a work management platform
  • CAPM, CSM, PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or equivalent preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Subject matter familiarity in digital marketing (e.g.: SEO, SEM, Content Marketing, Display, Feeds, Paid Social, Analytics, etc.)
  • Able to thrive in fast-paced environments and embrace change
  • Professional approach and comfort with conflict management and mediation
  • Ability to direct teams effectively in task prioritization and execution as well as facilitation of multiple projects simultaneously within a high-pressure environment
  • Excellent diplomatic, interpersonal, negotiation and communications skills with tenacity to solve internal and client problems quickly
  • Process driven, highly organized and methodical with excellent time management skills, strong business ethics, and political awareness
  • An enthusiastic and committed attitude, flexible problem-solver, open to participate and promote change within the organization
  • Self-starter with ability to think independently and work autonomously

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Consistent adoption of PMO templates and processes
  • Documented time savings achieved through PM task/work ownership
  • Projects/deliverables completed and delivered on-time

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Ensuring on-time delivery of all supported digital marketing deliverables
  • Establishing operational and project management best practices on supported accounts
  • Maintaining ongoing communication between the client and account team regarding the status of all projects and deliverables

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Medical Bonus
  • 15 paid vacation days (PTO) per year
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time 400.000 COP Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 17 observed Colombian national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Legal benefits like Prima, Cesantias
  • Paid Social Security
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. raw.description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About the role:

    The Vice President of Omnichannel is responsible for defining and executing the organization's client’s omnichannel vision, leading change management, creating personalized customer experiences that connect strategy, media activation, customer engagement, and technology infrastructure. This executive leads the development of next-generation engagement models that
    leverage customer data, AI, analytics, and marketing technology to deliver the right message, to the right audience, through the right channel, at the right time. The role serves as the connective tissue between commercial strategy, media, CRM, sales, analytics, medical, creative, and technology teams to build scalable omnichannel capabilities that improve customer experience and business performance. Reporting to the Chief Media Officer, this individual serves as the executive sponsor for omnichannel transformation and leads a high performing Omnichannel Center of Excellence.

What you'll do:

    Omnichannel Strategy

  • Develop the enterprise omnichannel vision and multi-year roadmap by assessing client omnichannel maturity and developing phased roadmaps using standardized omnichannel planning methodologies, engagement frameworks, and implementation playbooks tailored to each client’s technology ecosystem and organizational readiness.
    Create customer engagement strategies across HCP, patient, caregiver, payer, and consumer audiences
  • Design channel strategies spanning paid, owned, earned, CRM, field, point-of-care, social, search, email, websites, and emerging digital channels
  • Translate business objectives into integrated omnichannel customer journeys
  • Partner with brand teams to embed omnichannel planning into annual marketing strategies
  • Define governance models and omnichannel operating standards across the agency delivery team and client stakeholders

    • Change Management

  • Lead organizational change initiatives that support business transformation, operational excellence, and strategic growth with clients.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive change management strategies that minimize disruption while maximizing employee adoption.
  • Assess organizational readiness and identify potential risks, barriers, and resistance to change.
  • Create stakeholder engagement plans to build alignment across executive leadership, cross-functional teams, and external partners.
  • Develop communication plans that clearly articulate the vision, benefits, timelines, and expectations of organizational changes.
  • Establish change governance processes, including steering committees, decision frameworks, and escalation paths.
  • Monitor adoption metrics, employee feedback, and business performance to measure change effectiveness and recommend adjustments.
  • Develop and maintain change management documentation, playbooks, communication materials, and implementation plans.

    • Media Activation Leadership

  • Direct omnichannel media activation across all digital and traditional channels for client portfolios
  • Partner with media strategy teams to optimize investments using customer insights
  • Define the operating standards that connect paid media, CRM, websites, field marketing, and customer support into a unified engagement ecosystem
  • Guide audience segmentation and media personalization strategies
  • Develop attribution frameworks that measure cross-channel effectiveness
  • Drive optimization using real-time performance analytics

    • Next Best Engagement (NBE)

  • Build the NBE capability from the ground up, integrating the signals available today including CRM activity, website engagement, content consumption, media response — and sequencing claims, field, and sales interaction data as client access is secured. Design decision engines that determine the Next Best Action, Next Best Channel, Next Best Content, and Next Best Time
  • Create engagement rules and AI-driven personalization frameworks
  • Partner with Data Science to deploy machine learning models
  • Advocate for and secure the client-side filed data access required to integrate field and digital engagement into unified customer experiences
  • Lead cross-functional orchestration of strategy, creative, media, CRM, field engagement, analytics, and content teams to operationalize Next Best Engagement across customer journeys.

    • Omnichannel Infrastructure Development

  • Own the roadmap for omnichannel technology capabilities, including Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), CRM platforms, marketing automation, journey orchestration, identity resolution, AI decision engines, data warehouses, reporting environments, content management platforms, and personalization engines identity resolution, AI decision engines, data warehouses, reporting environments, content management platforms, and personalization engines
  • Identify capability gaps and build business case that moves client to prioritize technology investments
  • Partner with client and internal IT and Digital Experience teams to establish scalable omnichannel architecture

    • Customer Journey Design

  • Develop end-to-end customer journey frameworks
  • Identify friction points across digital and offline experiences
  • Create journey maps for priority customer segments
  • Build measurement frameworks around engagement milestones
  • Partner with UX, Creative, Medical, and Analytics teams to continuously optimize experiences

    • Data & Analytics Leadership

  • Champion data-driven decision making across the organization
  • Define omnichannel KPIs and engagement scorecards
  • Leverage customer analytics to improve segmentation and personalization
  • Coordinate the development of executive dashboards measuring engagement health with Analytics team
  • Partner with Business Intelligence and Data Science teams to translate predictive models into engagement logic

    • Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Drive organizational adoption of omnichannel capabilities through education, training, change management, and cross-functional enablement.
  • Lead collaboration across Media, Strategy, Creative, Medical, Commercial Operations, Sales, Analytics, Data Science, Technology, Client Services, Product, and Finance
  • Serve as the executive sponsor for omnichannel transformation initiatives
  • Foster a strong, collaborative culture and shared sense of purpose across departments

    • Innovation

  • Evaluate emerging technologies including AI, Generative AI, predictive analytics, and automation and partner with the Avalere Health AI Team to determine best use cases for clients
  • Pilot new customer engagement models and introduce innovative media activation strategies
  • Stay current on healthcare, pharmaceutical, and digital engagement trends
  • Build partnerships with technology vendors and strategic partners

    • Team Leadership, Culture & Communication

  • Build and lead a high-performing Omnichannel Center of Excellence
  • Mentor directors and senior managers, supporting career development and growth
  • Establish governance frameworks and omnichannel best practices
  • Manage departmental budgets and lead executive presentations
  • Support business development and client growth initiatives
  • Represent the organization externally through conferences and thought leadership

About you:

  • Executive-level experience in omnichannel marketing, digital strategy, media, CRM, customer engagement, or commercial excellence.
  • 12 to 15+ years of experience in relevant fields, including 7+ years leading cross-functional teams and enterprise-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Deep expertise in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences marketing, including HCP and patient engagement strategies.
  • Proven experience designing and scaling enterprise omnichannel engagement capabilities across digital, CRM, media, field, and customer support channels.
  • Strong understanding of customer data platforms (CDPs), CRM, marketing automation, AI, analytics, and personalization ecosystems.
  • Hands-on knowledge of leading marketing technology platforms such as Salesforce (Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud), Adobe Experience Cloud (AEM, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Real-Time CDP, Analytics), Veeva CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, and other enterprise marketing and customer engagement platforms.
  • Deep understanding of data privacy, consent management, and regulatory requirements impacting omnichannel marketing, including HIPAA, CAN-SPAM, TCPA, state privacy laws (such as CCPA/CPRA), GDPR, UK GDPR, ePrivacy Directive, and other global privacy regulations. Demonstrated ability to translate privacy and compliance requirements into scalable CRM and omnichannel engagement strategies across U.S. and international markets.
  • Experience partnering with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Medical, Commercial, and IT organizations to develop compliant omnichannel engagement models and governance.
  • Strong understanding of identity resolution, customer data management, consent and preference management, and first-party data strategies.
  • Proven experience leading organizational transformation initiatives, driving adoption of new technologies, operating models, and ways of working.

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.
We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy noticebefore applying to Avalere Health.

Become a part of our caring community

Humana, a Fortune 60 Healthcare Company

Humana is a publicly traded, Fortune 60 health benefits company with a long history of successful innovation and reinvention.  It has transformed itself from the largest US nursing home company in the ’60s, to the largest US hospital corporation in the ’80s, to a leading health benefits company beginning in the ’90s.  Today, Humana is a leader in consumer-focused health solutions and is one of the largest health benefits organizations in the country. 

The Consumer Products Enablement & Solutions department supports Humana’s businesses by ensuring consumer products are competitive and meet consumer needs. The team also enables growth across the organization and ensures timely CMS and state filing timelines.The team has a strong dotted-line partnership with the Medicare and Medicaid organization, Humana’s largest, which comprises over 80% of the company’s total revenue and the majority of its earnings. Team members partner broadly with leaders throughout the enterprise, as they provide oversight and strategic direction of all Medicare and Duals products.

Humana is seeking an experienced team member to help drive strategic direction and ensure execution on the end-to-end processes and projects critical for transformation across our business. As aConsultant, you will shape implementation considerations and work with business owners to translate analysis into execution and help drive enterprise alignment across Consumer Product, Growth Strategy, Transformation Office, Marketing, Compliance, and Operations. raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Sales Engineer at Samsara, you’d be an integral part of a diverse team working to help modernize essential industries through the application of cutting edge IoT solutions. Your work would directly contribute to a cleaner, more efficient and productive supply chain by creating safer roadways, reducing fuel consumption and emissions, and providing a consolidated platform for connecting operations. Our daily customer engagements include conversations around how IoT can positively impact logistics management, workplace safety programs, fleet maintenance strategies, global asset management, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful SE at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of the application of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on hardware installation strategies, managing data collection over carrier networks, presenting a robust cloud infrastructure, and building third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the best technical solution is presented to Samsara customers.


This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the Southeast region of the United States except for San Francisco Bay Metros, New York City Metro and Washington DC Metro. This position requires travel up to 50% of the time and proximity to an international airport is preferred.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.
  • Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve challenges common to their industry.
  • Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.

  • Ensures compliance with all quality-related regulatory audit guidelines by adhering to roadmap of deliverables and timelines, and implements solutions to maximize national Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) audit success.
  • Partners with cross-functional teams to ensure data quality delivery through sequential transformations and identifies opportunities to close quality care gaps.
  • Creates, reviews, and updates quality-related program documentation, including plans, reports, and records, and ensures information is accessible for quality teams throughout the enterprise.
  • Proactively communicates regular quality-related status reports to stakeholders, highlighting progress, risks, and issues.
  • Meets customer expectations and requirements, establishes, and maintains effective relationships and gains trust and respect.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of program/project management experience in quality, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Health care experience or demonstrated functional quality knowledge.
  • Intellectual agility and ability to simplify and clearly communicate complex concepts.
  • Proficiency with data analysis, manipulation, interpretation, and reporting.
  • Strong quantitative aptitude, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work cross-collaboratively in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Effective verbal, written and presentation communication skills.
  • Microsoft Office suite (including Excel) and applicable software programs proficiency, and ability to learn/navigate new software programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with running queries in Microsoft Azure or Structured Query Language (SQL) server.
  • Intermediate knowledge/experience related to National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), Healthcare Effectiveness Data Information Set (HEDIS), Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), and state-specific regulatory submission requirements.
  • Knowledge of health care claim elements: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT), CPT Category II (CPTII), Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC), Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine - Clinical Terms (SNOMED), Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPS), National Drug Code (NDC), CVX Codes (CVX), National Provider Identifiers (NPIs), and Taxpayer Identification Numbers (TINs).
  • Experience working in a cross-functional, highly matrixed organization, preferably within a managed care organization supporting Medicaid, Medicare, and/or Marketplace programs.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP).
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification, and/or comparable coursework.

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Our Brokerage Technology team is looking for a Senior Product Owner to join us in transforming the insurance brokerage industry and delivering innovative experiences to our customers. Will help drive the digital roadmap, representing the needs of the overall agent, member, or customer experience. Must be a self-starter who understands digital, customer, and business requirements, and can lead and manage change, remove roadblocks, and communicate clearly to multiple functional teams across digital portfolio and operations, technical, and business stakeholders. They will need to understand and work with stakeholders across the brokerage business lines, including Agent CRM, Agent Contracting, Commissions, and Call Center support.

We are seeking a strategic and technically adept Senior Product Owner to lead the evolution and optimization of our Medicare call center telephony systems, with a primary focus on Genesys Cloud CX AND Salesforce CRM. This role will support both internal operations and external brokerage partners, ensuring seamless, carrier-agnostic communication workflows that enhance customer experience and broker efficiency.

Responsibilities:

Product Ownership & Strategy

  • Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Medicare contact center ecosystem, including Genesys Cloud CX and Salesforce CRM.
  • Prioritize initiatives that improve agent productivity, customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
  • Act as the primary product liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and strategic vendor partners.
  • Ensure solutions support carrier-agnostic operations and align with brokerage and FMO business objectives.
  • Own and maintain the product backlog, translating business priorities into actionable user stories and release plans.

​Genesys Cloud CX Platform Management

  • Oversee the configuration, integration, performance, and ongoing optimization of Genesys Cloud CX.
  • Partner with technical teams to enhance IVR, call routing, workforce management, omni-channel engagement, and reporting capabilities.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of new contact center features and capabilities.
  • Manage vendor relationships, service-level agreements, and platform performance to ensure operational excellence.

Salesforce CRM Management

  • Own the strategy and evolution of Salesforce CRM supporting Medicare sales, enrollment, agent management, and customer service processes.
  • Drive seamless integration between Salesforce and Genesys Cloud CX, including CTI functionality, screen pops, interaction tracking, call logging, and workflow automation.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to design scalable CRM solutions that improve agent workflows and reduce administrative effort.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce administrators, developers, architects, and third-party partners to deliver enhancements, releases, and platform modernization initiatives.
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and consistency across customer, member, agent, and broker records while maximizing user adoption and business value.

Stakeholder Management & Delivery

  • Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Compliance, Agent Contracting, Commissions, Call Center Support, and external brokerage organizations to gather requirements and align priorities.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to remove roadblocks, manage dependencies, and ensure successful product delivery.
  • Communicate product strategy, roadmap updates, and business outcomes to executive and operational stakeholders.

Compliance & Quality

  • Ensure telephony and CRM solutions comply with CMS regulations, Medicare requirements, and internal governance standards.
  • Partner with quality, training, and operations teams to monitor performance, improve call quality, and enhance the overall customer and agent experience.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Define and monitor KPIs, dashboards, and reporting across Salesforce and Genesys to measure customer experience, agent effectiveness, and operational performance.
  • Leverage data-driven insights to identify opportunities, prioritize enhancements, and support strategic decision-making.
  • Collaborate with analytics teams to develop actionable reporting and performance measurement frameworks.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications:

  • Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or similar role in a call center or healthcare environment.

  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce ANDGenesys Cloud CX..

  • Experience working with Medicare sales operations, preferably within an FMO or brokerage setting.

  • Familiarity with carrier-agnostic workflows and CMS compliance requirements.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and agile delivery skills.

  • Experience with tools like Jira, Confluence, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Preferred:

  • Experience integrating telephony systems with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).

  • Knowledge of broker onboarding, lead distribution, and call tracking workflows.

  • Technical understanding of APIs and cloud-based contact center architecture.
